en: You mean our date? It's a disaster!?
Uh, um...
That's a terrible thing to say! You're the one who invited me, Yamada-kun!
Oh, no! I just mean, if I couldn't go on a date with you, Sato-san, it would be the biggest disaster I've ever faced!
Really? You're not just trying to backtrack?
Not at all! I wouldn't do that!
You're weird. Oh, well.
(Now she's upset. I should have gone with something else, I guess.)
Do you have any hobbies, Sato-san?
Yes, I'm a big fan of music! I've been listening to a lot of café-style tunes lately. Things like bossa nova and jazz.
Wow, that's awesome!
Do you like music as well, Yamada-kun?
Of course! I listen to music every night!
Then I guess we've got something in common! We should get along great!
You think so!?
What type of music do you like?
I only listen to anisongs! ...Oh, oops.
Anisongs? You mean anime theme songs?
Oh, uh, no. Why would I want to listen to that!?
That's not the anisongs I was talking about.
Then what were you talking about?
Um, when I said anisongs, I meant... Um... What was it again?
Well, anisongs is...
It's short for animal songs.
Yeah, that's it! It's short for animal songs!
Oh, I see. Like how they shorten rock and roll to just "rock."
That's right! It's just like that!
So, what kind of music are these animal songs?
Are there actually animals in it? Like furry little critters?
Yeah! CDs of actual animal noises! Likes birds, and cats, and...
Oh, so like ambient music? That's cool! You've got good taste, Yamada-kun!
(We got away with that somehow.)
They're a kind of chanson.
Yeah, that's it! I really like chansons!
Wow, you listen to chansons, Yamada-kun? I always thought they'd be a bit hard to get into. Maybe I'll try listening to a few sometime!
You should! Chansons are the best! I'm absolutely infatuated with them!
You've got sophisticated taste, Yamada-kun. I'd never have guessed! You're pretty cool!
It's the name of a singer.
Yeah, that's it! Most people haven't heard of him, but he has a pretty dedicated fanbase. He's a real legend!
Uh, I think his real name is Benjamin John Anisongs.
Oh, I've never heard of him. What kind of music does he make?
It's, uh... Really heavy, classical technopop.
Sounds a bit too eclectic for my taste. I can't even imagine what that sounds like.
If it was something a little more approachable I was going to ask to borrow a CD from you. But I guess our tastes are too different.
(That kind of spoiled the mood.)
Um, what kind of guys do you usually go for, Sato-san?
Let me think.
Handsome guys with good fashion sense, right?
No, appearance doesn't really matter to me.
Then is it all about their interests? Like active guys who know all the latest trends?
No, that stuff isn't all that important to me either.
It must be personality, then! I bet you like guys who are outgoing, have lots of friends, and can make you laugh.
Well, there's more to personality than that.
Then what kind of guy do you like, Sato-san?
Hmm. One thing I like is guys who are comfortable being themselves.
Comfortable being themselves?
Mmhm. It doesn't matter whether they're unattractive, have strange interests, or poor social skills...
As long as they're happy with who they are, and don't try to be fake. I like genuine people.
Genuine people...
That's right. That's the kind of guy I like.
What should I do, driver?
You should drop the act and just be yourself.
You sure about that? You don't think it will put her off?
I think you'll be fine, as long as you stay confident and keep your head held high.
Okay. Got it!
What's up, Yamada-kun? What were you and the driver talking about?
You want to know? Well, we were talking about the cute anime girls that I love so much!
I've got to be honest with you, Sato-san. The truth is, I'm obsessed with anime that have cute girls! There's really nothing else I'm interested in!
Hmm. Is that so...
Yeah! And I dream about going on dates with the characters! There are cute ones, moody ones, and even devoted maid types! All sorts!
What type are you, Sato-san? Any idea? You sure look cute, but maybe you have a moody streak? I bet a maid's uniform would look great on you!
Either way, there's one thing I can say for certain⑬I've got a crush on you! I hope we can make this work!
This is horrible.
Huh!? Why!? I was just showing you the real me!
What you spend your free time on is up to you, Yamada-kun. I won't criticize that. But it takes time to get to know someone!
If you took your time, I could maybe learn to accept that sort of thing. But this is just too much all at once!
You should try to be more considerate of other people's feelings.
Ugh. Game over...
(I didn't give him very good advice.)
I guess I should admit I'm really a big nerd, shouldn't I?
But is it best to just blurt it all out? Or should I try to hinting at it to start with?
I think it's important to apologize sincerely for trying to deceive her.
Right. That comes first, doesn't it?
What's up, Yamada-kun?
I've been lying to you, Sato-san.
What? Lying?
Yes. About the meaning of meatspace, and about my taste in music.
I see. Why would you lie though?
The truth is... I'm obsessed with anime!
I'm sorry I deceived you. You must hate me now, right?
I actually think it's great that you're passionate about something.
It doesn't matter what it is. There are plenty of people out there who don't care about anything.
Sato-san...
Hey, maybe you can show me a bit about why you think anime is great, Yamada-kun!
What? You want me to teach you about anime?
Sure. You'll have to take it slow, though.
Wait. Does that mean you're willing to see me again?
Yeah, of course. Let's take our time getting to know each other.
ZOMG!
Heheh, you're funny!
(I'm glad my advice worked out.)
Owning up to the fact you lied is probably only going to make her hate you.
So I should just keep my nerdy side hidden?
Yes. At least for today.
Okay. I'll do my best!
Uh, we were just talking about the beach. He and I are both surfers.
You surf, Yamada-kun!? I'd never have guessed!
Oh, yeah! The waves were real good yesterday, so I went and caught a few sets!
Cool, huh?
That's pretty brave... in the middle of winter and all.
Oh, uh, oops. Maybe I meant to say snowboarding? Ahaha...
Are you sure you're not hiding something, Yamada-kun?
What do you mean? I've got nothing to hide! Nope. Not a thing!
Why do you ask? I never said anything about my nerdy obsessions... Ah! Damn it!
Nerdy obsessions?
Oh, I mean, not that I have any of those! I'm not obsessed with cute anime girls or anything!
Yamada-kun...
I don't mind what you do in your free time. But I hate that you're lying to try and hide it.
Like I said, I like guys who are comfortable being themselves. I'm not sure I can respect you if you act like this, Yamada-kun.
I really pwned myself.
(It looks like I gave him some bad advice.)
Thanks for helping me out, driver! I think things might work out with her!
Here's the fare, and a tip on top!
I'll be sure to ask for you again. Bye!
Thank you! I'll do my best to make things work with her.
Bye!
I kind of get the feeling things would have gone better if I didn't follow your advice.
Ah. Sorry about that.
Yeah... I'm heading home to watch my anime.
I was told on the phone you'd be here in five minutes! You're late by fifteen seconds!
I'm sorry. The road was a little congested.
Now you're making excuses!? I don't believe it. I've never had a driver this rude before!
I'm going to complain to the taxi bureau.
Hmph. Well, I'll let it slide this time. Hurry up and let me in already.
(Looks like this is one of those passengers that complains about everything.)
Get me to <Color:22>Nagasu Boulevard<Color:Default> in three minutes. Got it?
(There's no way I'll make it in three minutes.)
I'm very sorry, but I don't think it's possible to get you there in three minutes.
Why not!? The last taxi I took got me there in three minutes!
Are you telling me you won't do what I ask? I'm going to complain to the taxi bureau!
What time was it when you last took this trip?
Oh... It was two or three in the morning.
Well, at that time of night it might be doable, but right now the roads are busy.
Hmph. Well, just go as fast as you can.
(She seems to have settled down.)
Okay. I'll do the best I can.
That's vague! Can I count on getting there within three minutes or not!?
If you can't, I'm putting in a complaint with the taxi bureau! And I'll expect compensation.
Well, can you or can you not!?
I'm sorry, I'm afraid it's not possible to get you there in three minutes.
Ugh! Why didn't you say so in the first place, then!?
Hmph. Well, let's get moving.
(She seems to have calmed down.)
(I'll pretend I didn't hear her.)
What!? Are you ignoring me? You horrible man! I feel completely disrespected!
I'm going to file a complaint... No, scratch that! I'll launch a civil suit against you!
(I have to calm her down somehow.)
I'm sorry, ma'am, but it will be difficult to get you there in three minutes.
(It's never a good idea to ignore a complainer.)
Gah! That noise is bugging me!
Noise?
That blowing sound!
Oh, that's just the sound of the heater.
Well, it's really getting on my nerves. Gah!
(If the sound bugs her, I'll just turn it off.)
Brr, now I'm getting chilly! Why is it so cold in here all of a sudden!?
I turned the heater off.
Why would you do that? It's freezing out there. Are you going to pay my medical bills if I catch a cold!?
You said it was noisy.
Well, yes, but I never told you to turn it off!
I'm calling the taxi bureau up right now!
I'm very sorry. I should have asked you before I turned it off.
Hmph. Well, since you apologized, I suppose I'll let it go this time.
(That settles that for now.)
Shall I turn the heater off?
What? If you switch off the heater on a cold day like this, I'd catch a cold! Are you going to pay my medical bills!?
Then it's fine to leave it on?
Yeah, yeah, just leave the damned thing on.
What about the noise?
Tch. I'm used to it now.
(If I turn the heater off, it'll get cold. I'll just leave it on.)
Grr, that noise is really starting to grate on my nerves!
It's really driving me crazy!
Don't you care about your passengers!? Do something about it!
But if I turn it off, it will get cold.
I wasn't asking for your opinion! I'm the customer, aren't I? The customer is always right!
I've never been treated this unjustly before. I'll be filing a complaint with the taxi bureau!
I'm very sorry. What would you like me to do with the heater?
Oh, just leave it on! But if you slip up again, I'm making that call, you hear!?
(It's never a good idea to ignore a complainer, I guess.)
(That's where she wanted me to drop her, but...)
Ma'am? There's a truck parked where you wanted me to drop you, so I'll stop a bit short.
What!? You won't drop me where I asked you to!?
It's only a few meters away.
Ugh! Fine.
I apologize for the inconvenience.
Yeah, well, you realize you won't get paid now, right?
Isn't that how it goes? It's your job to take me where I ask you to.
Whether a few meters or a few hundred meters, I don't have to pay if you don't drop me there.
Or do you want me to complain to the bureau that you didn't bring me to where I wanted to go!?
I could get your license revoked, you know! I could shut down your entire company!
Got it? I'm not just bullying you! I'm trying to uphold standards here!
(She's really going too far. What am I going to do now?)
(I should avoid getting emotional here, and try persuading her calmly.)
Excuse me, ma'am? There may have been some deficiencies with my service, and I apologize for that.
Hmph! Deficiencies all over the place! You didn't even take me the whole way!
Well, can you tell me how I could take you to the spot you requested, under the circumstances?
Uh... Huh!?
You'll have to forgive me, but I haven't been doing this very long. I'd like to hear what you suggest I do.
You did say you wanted to improve the standards of service.
Yeah, but... Oh, never mind. Just pull up here.
(That seems to have calmed her down.)
(I'll just let loose and yell at her.)
Come at me, you bellyacher! I'll take you down a notch!
(Did that work?)
WHAT!? Have you got a screw loose or something!?
I'll come at you all right! One call to the complaints center and you'll be history!
Let me out right here! You messed with the wrong lady, pal!
